name: Assistance For Purchase of Aids/Appliances
description: The "Assistance for Purchase of Aids/Appliances" scheme is to provide support to individuals with disabilities by facilitating access to assistive devices and appliances.
category: Women and Child, Health & Wellness, Social welfare & Empowerment

name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles, Denture, Hearing Aid (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be granted to the workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB for the purchase of Spectacles, Denture and Hearing Aid.

name: Financial Assistance for the Marriage of Daughters of Widows/Destitute Women belonging to the Scheduled Caste
description: By the Chandigarh Government, this scheme is initiated to reduce the financial burden for the girl marriage. Under the scheme financial assistance will be provided.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Sewing Machine (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be given to the spouse of registered male construction workers or female construction workers for purchase of sewing machine, once in life time.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Financial Assistance on Death/Disablement of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be provided to registered construction workers with full or 50% disability due to an accident. The financial assistance will also be provided to the widowed dependents of registered male construction workers for any reason of death.

name: Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women
description: The scheme "Financial Assistance To Dependent Children of Widows And Destitute Women" is a Social Welfare scheme by the Dept. of Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Govt. of Chandigarh; to extend financial assistance (₹ 1000/- per month per child) to children who are…
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Financial Assistance to Physically/Mentally Disabled Children of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, registered construction workers whose child has a disability of 40% or more will receive financial assistance.

name: Funeral Assistance (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be given to the legal heirs, in case of death of registered workers under the CBOCWWB.

name: Integrated Child Development Services: Chandigarh
description: The Integrated Child Development Service (ICDS) Scheme providing for supplementary nutrition, immunization and pre-school education to the children is a popular flagship programme of the government. Launched in 1975, it is one of the world’s largest programmes providing for an…

name: Interest Free Loan (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, interest free loan shall be granted to the registered construction workers of the Board for the purchase of items like Fridge, Television/ LCD, Motor Cycle/Scooter, Cooler, Fan & Bicycle.
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment

name: Kanyadaan Scheme (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance will be granted to the workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the eve of the marriage of his/her daughter and self-marriage of female registered workers.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Maternity Benefit (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance shall be given to the spouse of registered beneficiary woman employee after the delivery of child.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Old Age Pension - Chandigarh
description: The Old Age Pension scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to elderly citizens who have reached a certain age and require regular income for their sustenance.

name: Pension To The Disabled Person
description: The objective of the pension to the disabled person scheme is providing a pension to disabled persons is multifaceted, but generally centers around promoting social welfare, equity, and inclusivity.

name: Pension To Widows And Destitute Women-Chandigarh
description: Under the Pension To Widows And Destitute Women scheme To provide financial assistance to Widows and Destitute Women of Chandigarh.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child

name: Petrol Subsidy To Persons With Disability
description: Under the Petrol Subsidy To Persons With Disability scheme handicapped person using motorized vehicles are entitled to 50% subsidy on actual expenditure on the purchase of petrol/diesel subject to fulfillment of other conditions laid down under the scheme.

name: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of scholarship shall be granted to the children/wards of workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in 10th, 12th & Graduation.

name: Supply of Tri-Cycles (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, Tri-Cycles will be provided by the Board to the disabled registered construction workers and their dependents, once in life time.

name: Unemployment Allowance to Disabled Persons
description: The Unemployment Allowance To Disabled Person scheme provides financial support to unemployed handicapped individuals who have been waiting for employment for an unduly long period.

name: Widow Pension (CBOCWWB)
description: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
